dedupe_keys.name: ministry of transport of the russian federation open data

description: The Ministry of Transport of the Russian Federation publishes 36 open data sets, all as CSV, with a register of sets and a passport for each. Transport-relevant sets include the register of regular interregional bus routes, the register of regular international bus routes, stopping points on interregional routes with their services, tariffs and numbers of departures, the categories of public roads of federal, regional and intermunicipal importance, indicators of the state programme Development of the Transport System, including values by region, federal budget spending and financing in transport, and international transport agreements. Others cover inspections, licences, procurement and administration. Coverage is national. The terms follow the 2016 standard conditions: free, perpetual and worldwide use, including commercial use and derived works, provided the data are used lawfully, not distorted and cited. Access: free download without registration. Caveats: pages are in Russian, some sets are thin or administrative, and the checkpoint set read on 26 September 2026 showed an empty passport. The data support intercity bus network models, road classification for network flow studies and tracking of programme targets. They complement the Roszheldor and Rosaviatsia open data catalogued here.
